Renewable energy siting in Italy, pipeline status

Where Italy builds
solar and wind

A presence-background model of utility-scale plants, ported from the US study: four classifiers, 26 predictors, 1 km probability surfaces. The random-CV results hold; the spatial-CV and part of the GLMM need a fix before they go in the paper.

Most presence points are municipal totals, not plants

GEM trackers give named plants with coordinates. RSE Atlante adds every comune with at least 1 MW of ground-mounted PV (2021) or wind (2019), placed at the comune centroid.

Why wind is easier
Wind farms cluster on Apennine ridges and in the South; spatial lag alone separates presences (lag 1.7 to 2.1 SD) from background (0.7 SD).
modeling.R solar_resamps, wind_resamps; caret, twoClassSummary

After the zone-and-treat fix, spatial AUC drops below random CV

Tagging each coordinate lookup with its treat value before the join halved the row count back to the correct number. Spatial block CV now shows the expected optimism gap: ~0.03 AUC for solar, ~0.04–0.05 for wind.

Solar rows in spatial CV vs solar.csv
2,403 = 2,403
Row count now matches (was 3,621 bugged — presences doubled). Wind: 653 = 653 (was 939).
Fix applied to spatial_cv.R
- left_join(coords, by = "zone")
+ coords_s <- bind_rows(
+   mutate(presence_xy_s, treat = "X1"),
+   mutate(absence_xy_s,  treat = "X0"))
+ left_join(coords, by = c("zone", "treat"))
Solar GBM: random 0.76, spatial 0.73 (−0.03). Wind GBM: random 0.87, spatial 0.83 (−0.04). Report both.
spatial_cv.R blockCV 50 km blocks, k = 5; fold scores at the best tune from mdl_*_spatialcv.rds

Regional slopes: Puglia stands out for solar; wind slopes converge jointly

Solar: GLMM with one random slope per variable by NUTS-2 region. Wind: joint three-slope GLMM (cf + tx + lag | region) converged with the corrected training data. Bars are ±1.96 posterior SD. Intercept-only fallbacks are labelled in figure 4.

Solar env score: intercept-only fallback
labelled in f4
Slope was singular — env effect is uniform nationally. Regional intercepts show Puglia with the highest solar baseline; Alpine regions the lowest.
Wind: joint slopes converged
cf, tx, lag
Spatial lag shows the strongest regional spread. Capacity factor slopes vary North–South as expected; transmission dist is most negative in the South.
data.R RE(), objects s_d, w_d in total.RData; lme4, nAGQ = 0

What the numbers rest on

  • Locations95% of solar and 80% of wind presences are comune centroids from RSECovariates describe the comune centre, not the plant footprint. Comuni with several plants count once.
  • ResourceERA5 climate (25 variables, 2000–2020 means), LUH3 land-use fractions (12 variables, 2020), and MODIS NDVI (2003–2020 mean) now in predictor stack via WorldTensor. WorldClim BIO1–19 also added.PVGIS capacity factors for solar still pending. Capacity factor was 9th/10th by tree importance with proxies.
  • PolicyThe FER incentive variable is constant across Italy and is droppedThe US model's RPS term has no Italian counterpart until GSE zone polygons are added.
  • PrevalencePresence and background are near 1:1Probabilities rank cells; they are not the chance of a plant.
  • GridModels learn from today's ≥110 kV grid; the maps use the planned onezonal.R swaps in transmission_110_wPlanned and substations_110_wPlanned for prediction, as in the US study.
README.md, pipeline_summary.html, make_variables_italy.R

Before the paper

  • spatial_cv.R ✓Zone-and-treat join applied; RF and GBM rerun; random and spatial AUC reported side by side.Spatial AUC now below random CV as expected.
  • modeling.R ✓lulc_other dropped as reference; region_isole dropped as region baseline.All four GLMs now use region_model — no copy-paste divergence.
  • data.R ✓Wind joint 3-slope GLMM converged; solar env intercept-only labelled in figure 4.panel_label propagates to map titles too.
  • WorldTensor ✓534 ERA5/LUH3/NDVI .nc files downloaded from Zenodo ZIPs via HTTP range extraction (remotezip).Previous script tried direct .nc URLs — all 404. Files live in ZIP archives. ERA5 25 vars 2000–2020 means, LUH3 12 land-use fractions 2020 (NA→0 = land type absent), NDVI 2003–2020 mean.
  • WorldClim ✓BIO1–19 bioclimatic variables downloaded and snapped to 1 km Italy grid.Previously only srad and wind proxies; now full BIO stack. 24 TIFs (220–250 MB each) accidentally committed to git history — removed with git filter-repo and force-pushed.
  • modeling.R NA fix ✓luh3_c4per is all-NA in Italy (C4 perennial crops simply absent); na.omit() was dropping every row.impute_dat() now replaces LUH3 NAs with 0 and other numeric NAs with column median. Scientifically defensible: 0 fraction = land type not present, not missing data.
  • Figure 2 filter ✓Only significant predictors (p < 0.05) now shown in coefficient plot.Was showing all 90+ predictors, unreadable. Filter: color == “Y” in rst_s and rst_w.
  • InputsPVGIS capacity factors and GSE incentive zones still pending; then rerun run_setup() and run_all.R.
  • ChecksPrecision / recall / F1 by threshold, area of applicability (CAST), calibration curves, GEM-only temporal hold-out
